name: Website Studio
description: A hand-built site: pages, styles, and a live preview while you work

fileTypes.label: Page
fileTypes.template: {{title}}

actions.label: Make it responsive
actions.prompt: Review this page and its stylesheet for small screens: fluid widths, readable font sizes, no horizontal scroll, sensible breakpoints. Edit the files directly.

actions.label: Check links and assets
actions.prompt: Walk every page in pages/: verify each internal link points at a page that exists and each asset reference (css, js, images) resolves inside the project. Fix what's broken and list what you fixed.
